jules_sales: Quick sync14 Prospect Aurora wants a POC with committed capacity. They expect steady ~320 qps, spikes to ~1.6k qps for marketing blasts. Mix: chat (~60%, 130 tokens) + embedding lookups (~40%, 512 dim). Need recommended reserved GPUs, autoscale plan, and a preheat estimate.
noah_sre: Region? model? AZ constraints? Also they asked for p99 SLA clarity.
anya_eng: Pinned model: redwood/llm-7b-quantized in eu-central-1. Peak concurrency ~1100. Effective mixed throughput ~58-65 qps/GPU on A100-80GB. Rough reserve calc: steady 320 -> 6 GPUs. Peak 1600 -> ~25-28 GPUs total. Recommend reserve 6 + burst up to 20.
sam_solution: Pricing ask: customer wants a simple monthly reserved line item + capped burst credit pool and a one-time preheat add-on for campaign starts. They also require KMS + audit for HIPAA.
noah_sre: Autoscale knobs: min_nodes=6, max_nodes=28, scale_up window 60s, scale_down cooldown 600s. Recommend AZ spread (3 AZs) for reserved nodes. Note: p99 depends on warmed KV; cold spikes can breach p99.
anya_eng: Preheat estimate: warming common prefixes ~160M tokens -> ~3 GPU-hours/region. Recommend a 4-6 hour preheat window before big campaigns. Cross-region replication doubles preheat and replication cost.
sam_solution: Fallback policy: route overflow to llm-7b-q4f16 with a 10% canary during surge; monitor embedding cosine/QA metrics and cap fallback to 50% if quality acceptable. Include this in contract as configurable.
noah_sre: Ops runbook items: preheat checklist, KV hit dashboards, tail-latency alarms, burst soft-cap & throttling recipe. Add legal note on KMS key ARN and SOC2 attestation.
jules_sales: Great. I'll share draft pricing: 6 reserved GPUs at M/mo, burst credits up to 20 GPUs billed per GPU-hour at B/hr, optional 6 GPU-hr preheat block for P/one-time. infra-bot: please create ticket.
infra-bot: Created ticket #PR-9317: "Aurora POC 1: sizing + preheat runbook + KMS wording" assigned to anya_eng, noah_sre, due 2026-04-08. :white_check_mark:
jules_sales: Thanks team 44d I'll schedule the customer call for Tue 10am CET.
